_comment: Curated offline knowledge packs. 'name' + 'flavour' identify the pack in the Kiwix catalog (library.kiwix.org); exact download URL and current size are fetched live at download time. 'approx_gb' is only a guide for the menu. Packs sharing a 'group' are different sizes of the same content — you normally want just one from a group.

essentials.label: Essentials (~6 GB)
essentials.desc: Survival + medical core, compact Wikipedia. Fits anywhere, downloads fast.

prepared.label: Prepared (~65 GB)
prepared.desc: Essentials + full Wikipedia (text, no images), repair guides, travel, more medical.

everything.label: Everything (~145 GB)
everything.desc: Prepared, but full Wikipedia WITH images, plus the dictionary.

packs.name: zimgit-post-disaster_en
packs.title: Post Disaster Resource Library
packs.desc: Curated survival guides for when infrastructure is down: shelter, fire, signaling, sanitation.

packs.name: zimgit-food-preparation_en
packs.title: Food Preparation Library
packs.desc: Food storage, preservation, and cooking without modern appliances.

packs.name: outdoors.stackexchange.com_en_all
packs.title: Outdoors Q&A (Stack Exchange)
packs.desc: Thousands of real questions and answers on camping, navigation, and wilderness skills.

packs.name: zimgit-medicine_en
packs.title: Emergency Medical Library
packs.desc: Field-medicine handbooks for treating people when no doctor is available.

packs.name: wikipedia_en_medicine
packs.title: WikiMed Medical Encyclopedia
packs.desc: Every medical article on Wikipedia: conditions, drugs, procedures, anatomy.

packs.name: mdwiki_en_all
packs.title: MDWiki (physician-curated)
packs.desc: Medical reference maintained by physicians, based on WikiProject Medicine.

packs.name: wikipedia_en-simple_all
packs.title: Simple English Wikipedia
packs.desc: All of Simple English Wikipedia — plain language, with pictures. Great small encyclopedia.

packs.name: wikipedia_en_top
packs.title: Wikipedia: Top Articles
packs.desc: The most-read Wikipedia articles, full text with pictures.

packs.name: wikipedia_en_all
packs.title: Full Wikipedia (intros only)
packs.desc: Every English Wikipedia article, but only the introduction of each. No images.

packs.name: wikipedia_en_all
packs.title: Full Wikipedia (no images)
packs.desc: Every English Wikipedia article, complete text, no images. The sweet spot.

packs.name: wikipedia_en_all
packs.title: Full Wikipedia (with images)
packs.desc: The whole thing: every English article with images. The crown jewel.

packs.name: ifixit_en_all
packs.title: iFixit Repair Guides
packs.desc: Step-by-step photo repair guides for electronics, appliances, and vehicles.

packs.name: diy.stackexchange.com_en_all
packs.title: Home Improvement Q&A (Stack Exchange)
packs.desc: Real-world answers on plumbing, electrical, structural, and general home repair.

packs.name: wikivoyage_en_all
packs.title: Wikivoyage Travel Guides
packs.desc: Travel guides for the whole world: routes, regions, practical local info.

packs.name: wiktionary_en_all
packs.title: Wiktionary Dictionary
packs.desc: Full English dictionary and thesaurus, plus translations.

packs.name: survivorlibrary.com_en_all
packs.title: Survivor Library (pre-industrial tech)
packs.desc: Massive scanned-book archive on rebuilding technology without modern industry. WARNING: ~205 GB download.
